note: The prompt templates a kind profile names, one per built-in kind plus `generic`, `anchor` and `video`. A template is what makes `gen image` one command rather than one per kind - see specs/gen-fal/design.md. `{prompt}` is what the caller asked for and is substituted verbatim; `{width}` and `{height}` are the kind's cell, which is the *logical* sprite cell and not the size the image is generated at. Templates ask for the flat chroma green core/bgremove.py keys by default, because generating on a background `tool bgremove` cannot remove is how a paid image becomes unusable - `box-art` is the one exception, and it is deliberate: box art keeps its setting because it is never cut out. Magenta is the other preset and is the better key for a character carrying a lot of green, but it has to be asked for on both sides: the prompt and `bgremove --chroma magenta`. A template may also name any of `gen.VARIABLES` as `{name}`, `{prop}` and so on; every one it names must be supplied with `--var`, and a call missing one is refused rather than sent, because the literal text `{name}` in a paid prompt is the failure this exists to stop. `video` and `walk` overlap heavily on purpose: `video` is the base every in-place animation needs and `walk` is that base plus the motion of a walk cycle, and folding the two into one would tell an idle animation to alternate its legs.

templates.generic:
{prompt}

A single game asset, drawn flat and centred, on a solid #00b140 chroma-green background. No shadow, no gradient background, no text, no watermark, no frame.
templates.character:
{prompt}

A single game character sprite for a {width}x{height} pixel cell, drawn large enough that every sprite pixel lands as a clean block. Full body, side-on, feet flat on an invisible ground line, chunky readable silhouette, consistent limb proportions. Flat cel shading with small highlight pixels, hard edges, one consistent light source from the top left, no motion blur, no depth of field. Solid #00b140 chroma-green background, no shadow, no ground plane, no text, no watermark. No photorealism, no painterly blending, no anti-aliased edges.
templates.anchor:
{prompt}

The canonical South-facing idle frame for {name}, a {archetype}: one {width}x{height} logical sprite cell, drawn large enough that every sprite pixel lands as a clean block. One character only, centred, whole body inside the cell, facing the camera in three-quarter top-down perspective, feet planted at bottom centre. A calm, readable idle - not an attack, not a stride, and carrying nothing the character should not be holding in every single frame derived from this one. Wearing {costume}, carrying {prop}. Hold the silhouette: {silhouette}. Polished 16-bit console sprite work: chunky readable silhouette, crisp edges, limited flat shading with small highlight pixels, one consistent light source from the top left. Any image supplied alongside this prompt is a pixel-grid reference: take block discipline from it and never take its content. Solid #00b140 chroma-green background outside the silhouette, no scenery, no ground plane, no shadow, no border, no text, no watermark. No photorealism, no painterly blending, no anti-aliased edges.
templates.direction:
{prompt}

The same character as the supplied anchor - {name} - redrawn as a {width}x{height} logical sprite cell facing {direction}, in the same neutral idle stance. Hold the direction-specific silhouette: {silhouette}. Preserve the identity exactly: same outfit, same palette, same proportions, same accessories, same silhouette weight and the same pixel treatment, so that this frame and the anchor read as one character rather than two. Both feet visible and planted on one baseline, hands neutral and empty, whole body inside the cell with even padding on every side. Accessories stay where they naturally sit on the body from this view - a prop that would be awkward here becomes less visible rather than moving to the wrong side of the body. This is a neutral anchor that walk, idle and attack frames will later be generated from, so no action pose, no glow, no particles, no projectile, no aura, no flame, and no drawn weapon unless the character carries it at rest. Solid #00b140 chroma-green background, no shadow, no ground plane, no scenery, no second character, no text, no watermark.
templates.neutral-pose:
{prompt}

Redraw {name} as its canonical South-facing neutral idle, at {width}x{height} logical sprite size. The supplied image is the identity to preserve: keep the same face, silhouette, proportions, costume colours, prop size and detail, centred composition and sprite scale. The one intended correction is to remove {remove}. Beyond that, the pose - hands empty and resting naturally, weight settled, a calm readable idle. Remove every glow, particle, trail, smoke, aura, projectile and charged wind-up, so that nothing remains that the character should not be holding in every single frame derived from this one. Keep the crisp pixel treatment, hard edges, and one consistent light source from the top left. Solid #00b140 chroma-green background outside the silhouette, uniform, with no gradient, no noise, no shadow, no scenery, no border, no text, no watermark. Do not redesign the character, do not simplify identifying detail, and do not change the scale or the silhouette.
templates.icon:
{prompt}

A single game icon for a {width}x{height} cell. One object, centred, filling the cell with a small even margin, high-contrast silhouette that reads at a glance when small. Flat cel shading, hard edges. Solid #00b140 chroma-green background, no shadow, no text, no watermark.
templates.tile:
{prompt}

A single seamless terrain tile, {width}x{height}. The pattern continues across every edge so the tile meets itself when repeated: no border, no vignette, no framing, no single dominant feature in the middle. Even lighting from directly above, flat texture, no perspective, no shadow, no text, no watermark.
templates.ui:
{prompt}

A single game UI panel, {width}x{height}, drawn straight on with no perspective. A uniform border of even thickness on all four sides and a plain fillable centre, so it can be stretched as a nine-patch. Flat shading, hard edges. Solid #00b140 chroma-green background outside the panel, no shadow, no text, no watermark.
templates.banner:
{prompt}

A single wide game banner, {width}x{height}. Composition reads across the width, with the subject left of centre and clear space for a title. Flat shading, hard edges, no letterboxing. Solid #00b140 chroma-green background behind any cut-out subject, no text, no watermark.
templates.background:
{prompt}

One parallax background layer, {width}x{height}, drawn straight on with no perspective and no camera vignette. The composition tiles horizontally: the left and right edges continue into each other. Even lighting, flat shading, no foreground characters, no text, no watermark.
templates.map:
{prompt}

A single top-down map piece, {width}x{height}, drawn from directly above with no perspective and no isometric skew. Even lighting, flat shading, consistent scale across the whole piece. Solid #00b140 chroma-green background outside the piece, no shadow, no text, no watermark.
templates.box-art:
{prompt}

Character box art for a roster or character-select screen: {name}, a {archetype}, at {width}x{height}, portrait. Wearing {costume}, carrying {prop}, set in {setting}. Three-quarter hero composition, full body or near full body, filling most of the height. Painterly rendered illustration - not flat cel shading, not pixel art. The silhouette still reads as one clear shape, because this character exists as sprites elsewhere and the two have to look like the same person. The setting is this character's own - the place the description above puts them - and borrows no motif, palette or landmark from anywhere else in the roster. It sits behind and around them, supporting them, never crossing in front of them and never competing for the eye. No text, no logo, no UI, no watermark, no border, no frame, and no runes, glyphs or written symbols unless the description above asks for them.
templates.video:
{prompt}

Animate this single subject in place. Preserve the identity exactly as the input image has it - the same pixelated sprite look, proportions, palette, costume and silhouette - and hold the orientation the input image already has for the entire clip. It does not turn, pivot, rotate or show a quarter-turn view at any point, and does not translate across the frame. The camera is fixed and centred, the framing does not change, and the motion loops back to the first frame. The background stays the same flat neutral field it already is: it does not become a floor, a room, a horizon, an outdoor scene, a perspective grid or a shadow plane. One character, no scene, no added props, no labels, no arrows, no cuts, no zoom, no text, no watermark. No attack, no weapon swing, no magic, fireball, spell effect, smoke, particle, glow, trail or impact.
templates.walk:
{prompt}

Animate this single character into a simple in-place walk cycle, facing {direction} for the entire clip. Preserve the identity exactly as the input image has it - the same pixelated sprite look, proportions, palette, costume and silhouette. The character does not turn, pivot, rotate or show a quarter-turn view at any point, and does not translate across the frame. Low-fidelity readable game-sprite motion: alternating leg steps, subtle vertical bobbing, minimal arm swing, light clothing and equipment sway, both feet staying visible. The camera is fixed and centred, the framing does not change, and the cycle loops back to the first frame. The background stays the same flat neutral field it already is: it does not become a floor, a room, a horizon, an outdoor scene, a perspective grid or a shadow plane. One character, no scene, no added props, no labels, no arrows, no cuts, no zoom, no text, no watermark. No attack, no weapon swing, no magic, fireball, spell effect, smoke, particle, glow, trail or impact.
